title: CoreTech Innovations Overview
text: CoreTech Innovations is an enterprise software company headquartered in Nawabshah and Hyderabad Pakistan. The company designs builds and operates scalable software products for ambitious enterprises worldwide. They combine product strategy disciplined engineering cloud reliability and data intelligence to help clients move faster without losing control.

title: CoreTech Mission
text: CoreTech Innovations helps organizations design build modernize and operate business-critical software. From dedicated delivery pods to full platform ownership they bring the structure communication and technical maturity expected by enterprise teams globally.

title: CoreTech Leadership
text: CoreTech Innovations is led by Sufyan Arain as CEO and Founder, Shahzaib Shaikh as CEO and Co-Founder, and Jawwad Khamboh as CTO. The leadership team focuses on innovation client satisfaction technical vision software architecture and overall business growth.

title: CoreTech Statistics
text: CoreTech Innovations has 180 plus delivery experts including engineers strategists and product specialists. They have delivered 320 plus enterprise and growth-stage technology projects. The company maintains a 94 percent client retention rate and covers 12 time zones for responsive global delivery.

title: Pricing Models Overview
text: CoreTech Innovations offers flexible engagement-based pricing models including Fixed Price for well-defined projects Time and Materials for evolving requirements and Dedicated Team model for enterprises needing a full embedded engineering pod.

title: Starter Package
text: The CoreTech Starter Package is suited for small web or mobile projects up to 3 months with a small team of 2 to 3 engineers. Estimated range is 5000 to 15000 USD and includes discovery design development basic QA and launch support.

title: Growth Package
text: The CoreTech Growth Package covers medium enterprise projects lasting 3 to 6 months with a team of 4 to 6 engineers plus QA and designer. Estimated range is 20000 to 60000 USD including full discovery architecture design development QA deployment and 30 day support.

title: Enterprise Package
text: The CoreTech Enterprise Package covers large platform or ERP projects lasting 6 to 12 months with a full pod of 6 to 12 engineers QA designer and PM. Estimated range is 75000 to 250000 USD including full lifecycle delivery dedicated team compliance support and long-term maintenance.

title: Maintenance Retainer
text: CoreTech Innovations offers a Maintenance and Support Retainer for ongoing post-launch support ranging from 1000 to 5000 USD per month depending on SLA. Includes bug fixes performance monitoring minor feature updates and incident response.

title: Discovery and Scoping Phase
text: CoreTech project delivery begins with Discovery and Scoping including initial consultation to understand business context stakeholder interviews requirements gathering technical feasibility assessment and delivery model selection between dedicated pod staff augmentation or full platform ownership.

title: Architecture and Planning Phase
text: In the Architecture and Planning phase CoreTech designs the system architecture before development begins selects the technology stack plans security architecture creates the project roadmap with measurable milestones and allocates team resources.

title: Design Phase
text: The CoreTech Design phase includes UI/UX wireframing and prototyping user research and usability testing on prototypes design system creation for consistency and client approval before development begins.

title: Development Phase
text: CoreTech Development phase uses agile development in structured sprints with code reviews and pair programming continuous integration and automated testing regular client demos at sprint end and security checks embedded at every development stage.

title: Quality Assurance and Delivery
text: CoreTech QA and Delivery phase includes comprehensive testing covering functional performance security and regression testing bug fixing and performance optimization production deployment with zero-downtime strategy handover documentation and client sign-off.

title: Post-Launch Support
text: CoreTech Post-Launch Support includes a 30 day post-launch monitoring and support window with Client Care and Maintenance Support Services available ongoing covering performance monitoring incident response feature updates and long-term account management.
